trap.label: tempo futuro
trap.wrong: By June, we will be negotiating for two years.
trap.right: By June, we will have been negotiating for two years.
trap.why: Em português “em junho estaremos negociando há dois anos” usa futuro simples + há. Em inglês, para duração até um ponto futuro, use will have been + -ing.

fix.wrong: By May, I will have been wait for hours.
fix.right: By May, I will have been waiting for hours.

fix.wrong: By noon, we will been negotiating for ten hours.
fix.right: By noon, we will have been negotiating for ten hours.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “By June, we negotiate for two years.” (Future Perfect Continuous)
rewrite.answer: By June, we will have been negotiating for two years.

rewrite.prompt: Negativo: “I will have been sleeping much.”
rewrite.answer: I won’t have been sleeping much.

rewrite.prompt: Pergunta: “You will have been working for hours.”
rewrite.answer: Will you have been working for hours?
